name: Crystal Garden — site artifact sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Original map shows a floating planted crystal island with an airy glass/gold dome, pale terraces, pink blossoms, violet crystals and water spilling at the rim. It is a scene view, not an exact footprint or arrival route. Hidden layout inference: A declared sky arrival pad leads to a short garden loop around a reflective crystal pond and glass shelter; one overlook faces the mainland, and another path returns to the arrival anchor. Keep crystal outcrops at edges and gardens in usable pockets instead of blocking route with giant spikes. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "S01-ARTIFACT-001 — Crystal Garden — site artifact sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".
